Top-left corner: before / after

LCARS rules

  • Containment: a child never extends past its parent's outline. A segment takes its bar's thickness; a block takes its column's width; nothing overlaps or touches a frame line, hairline, elbow curve or another element.
  • No local bulges: a control that needs more room makes the whole bar that thick along its length, or it lives outside the bar as its own block.
  • Gaps, not overlaps: small gap 6 px between segments, blocks and strips; large gap 18 px between columns and panels; medium 12 px for data-frame hairlines.
  • Curves follow curves: every round elbow uses circular arcs only, scaled from the reference elbow: outer radius = 0.7 × arm width, inner radius = 1.4 × bar thickness (at most half the arm width); hairlines are concentric at a constant offset (6 px on the window, 12 px on data frames) and never fade: full opacity end to end, ending where they join another frame element or with a small square cap; the diagonal frame's bends are circular arcs too; no ellipses.
  • Titles: every title's cap height matches the bar or element it shares a row with (frame titles 42 px bar, window title 30 px bar, section headings 18 px row), flush with that row's segments, pills, tags and toggles, with the standard gaps before and after; no title is larger than its level allows.
  • Readouts never look like controls: a read-only meter is a filled bar ending flat, with a thin end tick at most; no knob, thumb or handle, no hover or cursor change; the tick scale stays faint. Knobs, thumbs and pills are only for things you can change.
  • Text on its own element: a title's cap height equals its bar's thickness, flush with the top and bottom of the bar's segments, a small gap after the elbow (window: 30 px bar, frames: 42 px title bar); hairlines follow the bar at their constant offset; labels sit inside their block, right and bottom aligned; text never crosses an edge.
  • One scale: spacing 6 / 12 / 18 px; bars thin 18, medium 30, large 42 (frame title bars), wide 60, thick 150 px (118 px below 1040 px).

Colour rule

  • Structure: slate and grey (frames, bars, nav blocks, labels).
  • Live values: steel (figures, the running stage, the live dot).
  • Key value: white (one per readout: the total, the top row).
  • Alert only: coral (missing tool solid, update needed soft).
  • Amber: the Auctum mark and the keyboard focus ring, nothing else.
  • Selection is brightness: a selected block turns light slate with black text.

Shape rule

  • Pills are actions: Resume, Park, Update, Choose…, Sign in, Rescan, Full screen.
  • Square blocks are navigation and readouts: arm, sub-blocks, tabs, list rows, chips.
  • A thin strip at a block's left edge carries its state: steel live, coral alert, outline parked, grey done.
  • No boxed cards: content floats on black inside three nested frames.

Frames

  • Round nested frame (thick outer, thinner inner, hairline) for Settings and Configuration.
  • Curved diagonal frame with parallel hairlines, content on plain black, for the intent head and the data views (Cost, Activity; later Velocity and an intent's Cost and Velocity tabs).
  • Titles head their bar on its baseline; a dark sub-label sits inside the bar, tags and actions at its far end.
  • Full screen sits at the end of the thin top bar; Hide / Show terminal at the end of the thin bottom bar, diagonally opposite.
  • Drawer (US-0415): every list column's heading row ends with the drawer toggle, and every list folds to the same 30 px stack (› block, count, live segment, vertical label): Intents and Activity (INTENTS), Features › Epics (EPICS), Features › Releases (RELEASES), the Editor's file tree (FILES).
